title: Implement IEC60870-5-7 Secure Authentication
description:
I started to implement dissection of IEC60870-5-7 Secure Authentication.  
Sample capture: [870sa.pcapng](/uploads/b4f2771c1407614a240d0fc8dc12aab5/870sa.pcapng)

What works:
 - reassemby of extended ASDUs using segmentation
 - S_IT_TC_1 <41> := integrated totals containing time tagged security statistics 
 - S_CH_NA_1 <81> := authentication challenge
 - S_RP_NA_1 <82> := authentication reply
 - S_AR_NA_1 <83> := aggressive mode authentication request
 - S_KR_NA_1 <84> := session key status request
 - S_KS_NA_1 <85> := session key status
 - S_KC_NA_1 <86> := session key change  
 - S_ER_NA_1 <87> := authentication error

TODO:
 - S_US_NA_1 <90> := user status change
 - S_UQ_NA_1 <91> := update key change request
 - S_UR_NA_1 <92> := update key change reply
 - S_UK_NA_1 <93> := update key change symmetric
 - S_UA_NA_1 <94> := update key change asymmetric
 - S_UC_NA_1 <95> := update key change confirmation

@geraldcombs 
can i get some help 

```
packet-iec104.c:2084:12: error: function 'dissect_iec60870_asdu_segment' is within a recursive call chain [misc-no-recursion,-warnings-as-errors]
packet-iec104.c:2162:13: error: function 'dissect_iec60870_segment' is within a recursive call chain [misc-no-recursion,-warnings-as-errors]
packet-iec104.c:2213:12: error: function 'dissect_iec60870_asdu' is within a recursive call chain [misc-no-recursion,-warnings-as-errors]
```

it is a new check ?

It is. Recursion warnings were added in January in 5f0672d749 and warnings-as-errors was enabled a couple of weeks ago in 2438e82c40.

Unbounded recursion can be guarded with `increment_dissection_depth` and `decrement_dissection_depth`. Once you're sure that's no longer an issue, you can disable the Clang-tidy warnings by putting `NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion)` before each of the lines above. See packet-gquic.c for an example.
